description:
r/IPMATtards Reddit Dataset
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains scraped posts and comments from the r/IPMATtards subreddit, a community dedicated to aspirants of the Integrated Programme in Management Aptitude Test (IPMAT) in India. 
The data is structured into two main components:

Posts: Top-level submissions including titles, body text, scores, and metadata.

author: shubhxho
description:
BhaveshShaha Reddit Dataset
	

This dataset contains Reddit user comments in multiple ML-ready formats.

	
		
		Configurations
	


full: Complete data with all fields
qa: Simple Q&A pairs with instruction/response format
alpaca: Alpaca-style instruction tuning format
sharegpt: ShareGPT conversation format


	
		
		Usage
	

from datasets import load_dataset

	
		
		Load specific configuration
	

dataset = load_dataset("shubhxho/BhaveshShaha", "alpaca", split="train")

description:
SPEALL — Synthetic Egocentric Manipulation Dataset
	

SPEALL is a multimodal egocentric manipulation dataset generated using Odyssey, a frontier interactive world model that streams physically consistent video in real time. Rather than collecting costly real-world demonstrations, SPEALL taps a generative world model as a scalable synthetic data source for training egocentric manipulation policies and world models.

Operator Video Quality — distillation-fidelity benchmark
